alerts.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued October 20 at 2:16AM EDT until October 21 at 4:00PM EDT by NWS Boston/Norton MA
alerts.description: * WHAT...Northeast winds 15 to 25 kt with gusts up to 30 kt and waves 2 to 4 feet expected. * WHERE...In Massachusetts coastal waters, Boston Harbor. In Rhode Island coastal waters, Narragansett Bay. * WHEN...From 8 AM Tuesday to 4 PM EDT Wednesday. * IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
alerts.instruction: Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.

alerts.description: * WHAT...Northeast winds 20 to 30 kt with gusts up to 40 kt and seas 4 to 7 feet expected. * WHERE...Portions of Massachusetts coastal waters and Rhode Island coastal waters. * WHEN...From 8 PM this evening to 8 PM EDT Wednesday. * IMPACTS...Strong winds will cause hazardous seas which could capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.
alerts.instruction: Mariners should alter plans to avoid these hazardous conditions. Remain in port, seek safe harbor, alter course, and/or secure the vessel for hazardous conditions.
